main.description: Builds an ordered feed skeleton from current indexed records for the registered feed and parameters selected in the request. Authentication is not required. The caller hydrates returned strong references separately.

errors.name: InvalidRequest
errors.description: The request is malformed or semantically invalid.

errors.name: UnsupportedFeed
errors.description: The requested feed identifier is not registered by this service.

errors.name: TrustedEvaluatorsTooLarge
errors.description: The trusted evaluator filter exceeds its supported size.

errors.name: InvalidKind
errors.description: The request contains an unsupported event kind.

errors.name: InvalidCursor
errors.description: The cursor is invalid or incompatible.

errors.name: InternalError
errors.description: The service encountered an internal error.

feedId.description: Identifier of the feed algorithm to execute.

params.description: Parameters for the selected feed algorithm.

schema.description: Returns ordered feed skeleton items with exact record references and an optional cursor for the next page.

cursor.description: Cursor for the next page. Omitted when no later page is known.

feedSkeletonItem.description: One classified feed event represented by its exact indexed record version.

feedTimestamp.description: Timestamp used to place this item in the feed, newest first. It uses the record's createdAt when valid; otherwise, it uses the time Hyperindex indexed the record.
